title: subtract and invert blend modes render as source-over in authoring canvas
description: In renderer.ts BLEND_MAP, subtract and invert have no Canvas2D equivalent and fall back to source-over. Fix: render the affected object to an offscreen canvas and apply pixel-level compositing via getImageData/putImageData. Subtract darkens by subtracting source RGB from destination; invert inverts destination pixels under the clip. SWF encoding already emits correct byte values.
